integrity_rules: Existing DCF scenario assumptions and source valuations are immutable in this review
All amounts in USD millions unless explicitly specified
Cash-flow statement paid cash, earnings accrual, future contractual payments and pending deal EV are different concepts
Comparative interim figures must never be annualized without a seasonality bridge
No analyst stress is allowed to become an issuer-reported fact
A resolved data tie-out is not an approved prospective economic valuation

notes: Do not deduct Semrush spent acquisition cash again from FY2025 owner cash.
Analyst recurring M&A reserve is not sourced to a recurring pipeline.
Original code grows the entire initial net cash including deducted reserve; an annual flat reserve is a different schedule.
Topaz closing transaction may be covered by assumed reinvestment reserve; avoid counting $340 twice.
Scheduled future lease payments include principal and interest; interest may already be in CFO and cannot be deducted again.
Uncommenced lease amount is disclosed payments for arrangements not yet commenced, not cash debt repayable today; some conditions may apply.
Noncash ROU recognition is not a second cash CAPEX outlay.
13% 5Y cash growth assumption needs Azure margin/replacement CAPEX and lease starts evidence.
Litigation cash changes are included within CFO and should not be deducted a second time.
Unrestricted owner cash is not interchangeable with litigation escrow.
Client incentives are not simply a discretionary expense: accrual and cash prepayment create temporal timing effects.
FY2026 is not public by 2026-10-25.
Previously CFO less PPE alone excluded capitalized software cash outlay.
Amortization of customer incentives and prepaid asset cash changes are different cash flow components; not a pure same-label net figure.
An earnings-derived payment industry cap is a valuation stress, not a GAAP cash identity.
BVNK paid purchase consideration and contingent outcomes must not be conflated with recurring owner free cash.
Direct CHIPS grants of 1,104m are investing cash and added to management adjusted FCF, not to GAAP CFO-CAPEX.
A separate $469m investment tax credit benefit is already reflected in LTM GAAP operating cash: stressing its recurrence is distinct.
Analyst capital cycle reserve of 1,818m is not issuer-reported maintenance CAPEX.
Acquisition EV is not necessarily equity check and committed loan capacity is not drawn debt.
